claim_text: I am happy to report that 71% of electricity needs were supplied by renewable sources in FY25
context_text: I am happy to report that 71% of electricity needs were supplied by renewable sources in FY25 and that an internal carbon price (ICP) was introduced throughout the business.；71% of electricity sourced from renewables.；In FY25, 71% of electricity across Sandfire was sourced from renewables rather than fossil fuel and as a result 238kt of CO2e was abated over the three years to 30 June 2025.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 71%的可再生电力占比在董事长致辞、FY25 Highlights和后文薪酬相关披露中被重复且一致地呈现，直接支持该声明。
notes: claim 自带数据，证据合并自多处重复披露。
